name: Kentucky

flag.description: A navy blue field with the state seal, two men shaking hands, ringed by UNITED WE STAND DIVIDED WE FALL, with COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY arched above and sprays of goldenrod below.
flag.symbolism: The handshake between a frontiersman and a statesman illustrates the state motto, "United we stand, divided we fall".

hook: Kentucky's seal-on-blue is the handshake: two men greeting each other under COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY.
trivia: The two men are popularly said to be Daniel Boone and Henry Clay, but officially they are just a frontiersman and a statesman.
Kentucky is one of four US states that officially call themselves a commonwealth.
